displayName: Niche 7: Bất công xã hội / Phân biệt đối xử
description: Urban thriller social-justice drama about discrimination on protected attributes (race, ethnicity, accent, religion, disability, age, body size, immigration status, gender identity, class), accessibility denial, service refusal, profiling, wrongful policing, institutional mistreatment, paper-trail evidence, policy reform, and public repair. The wound is bias on a protected attribute, never just rude rich-versus-poor humiliation (-> Niche 2).
emotionalAxis: discrimination wound on a protected attribute, urban thriller pressure of being misjudged in public, access denial, wrongful accusation, documented justice reveal, institutional repair beyond personal apology
coreKeywords: she did not have to prove she belonged

chapterArcDefaults.hookStyle: unfair public refusal, profiling, or accusation grounded in a protected attribute, with witnesses present

humiliationPacing: she is refused service or accessible entrance because of a protected attribute
manager, bouncer, officer, or crowd misjudges her through racism, classism, ableism, ageism, or accent bias
a 'community standards' or 'security concern' excuse is given on the record
the institution backs the discriminator publicly until the paper trail forces a turn
she is told to prove she belongs in a way that other guests are not asked to prove
the discriminator's manager or peer reinforces the bias in front of witnesses
her credentials, license, or membership are publicly questioned without basis
the truth is captured on body-cam, security footage, or signed witness statements
revengeActivation: the owner or authority reveal lands in the same venue that refused her
a public apology alone is judged insufficient; she demands policy change
ADA, EEOC, civil-rights, or licensing-board filing forces accountability
policy or workplace consequence (firing, license suspension, contract loss) is recorded
evidence forces institutional repair (training, audit, oversight, monitor)
she keeps dignity over spectacle and refuses to perform belonging on demand
she protects another targeted person first, before claiming her own restitution
settlement money is redirected to community programs that fix the root issue
the case becomes precedent in the same chain or industry that wronged her
dignityRecoveryTiming: clear justice payoff, careful and non-exploitative, with institutional repair and policy precedent rather than only a personal apology

belongsHere: discrimination on a protected attribute (race, accent, religion, disability, age, body size, immigration status, gender identity, class)
accessibility denial, service refusal, profiling, wrongful arrest reversal
ADA / EEOC / civil-rights / licensing-board paperwork as evidence engine
institutional repair, policy reform, training mandate, oversight monitor
non-extremist, careful, paper-trail justice that protects other targets too
doesNotBelongHere: general public humiliation without a protected-attribute wound (-> Niche 2)
office contract / paper marriage / hostile takeover (-> Niche 8)
campus bullying with student-stage reveal (-> Niche 10)
